technical-summary: RUM04 C43 binds the session's frozen measured-plan key to the exact Resolved input used by the real bc-serve unmeasured writer child. The writer recomputes and checks the key before building the draft; session also checks the pinned draft's config, model and ordered engine BDFs before measuring. Only the final successful round records its measurement attempt. Regression invokes the built bc-serve twice successfully and proves transient num_speculative_tokens drift is refused before any measuring attempt.
user-summary-candidate: The plan key is now checked inside the real manifest writer against the exact configuration used for the measuring draft, and transient settings changes are rejected before measurement starts.
